name: City of West Sacramento Lifeguard/Swim Instructor
org: City of West Sacramento Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You watch swimmers at the city pool during swim lessons, public swim and special events. You enforce pool rules, give first aid, help in emergencies and do some pool cleanup.
who_can_apply: At least 15 when you start. Before you start, you need cards for Lifeguard Training, CPR for the Professional Rescuer, First Aid and Title 22. A Water Safety Instructor card is a big plus. Past lifeguard work helps, but you do not need it.
pay_detail: $17.25 to $18.75 per hour (2026 posting). Temporary, extra help.
deadline_text: Not posted for 2027 yet. Last cycle: the 2026 Lifeguard/Swim Instructor posting opened Feb 5, 2026 and closed May 3, 2026. The 2023 posting ran Mar 2 to May 31, 2023. Expect a new posting around February 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the whole city job form online on NEOGOV. Add a resume. The city reads every form. The best fits go on a hiring list. The top people move to the next step.
notes: The posting does not list hours or season dates, so ask Parks and Recreation at (916) 617-4567. Get your lifeguard certificates before you apply, since they are required before you start. Paid work under 18 needs a California work permit. Teens 14 to 16 who are too young for this job can look at the city's unpaid Teen Heroes summer camp program.
